result.instructions: Tools for Revamp CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open deals are expected to close this month, and what are they worth?"; "Find the contact with email anna@example.com and show her deals and last order."; "Add a note to deal 66a1f0c2: customer wants a revised quote by Friday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Revamp CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run revampcrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run revampcrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run revampcrm_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. revampcrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: revampcrm_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Revamp CRM user the credentials belong to: id, name, email and role. Use the id as owner_user_id / assigned_user_id. GET /User/WhoAmI.

tools.name: revampcrm_list_contact_stages
tools.title: List contact stages
tools.description: The contact (lead) stage names configured in the account, in order. Use them as contact_stage filters and values. GET /Account/ContactStage.

tools.name: revampcrm_list_deal_currencies
tools.title: List deal currencies
tools.description: The currencies that deals in this account can use (name, value, symbol). GET /Account/DealCurrencies.

tools.name: revampcrm_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List contact custom fields
tools.description: The contact custom fields defined in the account: CustomFieldName (the property name, e.g. CustomField3), DisplayName, Type and list options. Read this to interpret CustomFieldN values on contacts and to set them. GET /Account/getAccountCustomFields.

tools.name: revampcrm_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: Search and list contacts (people and organizations), newest filters first. With no filter it lists all contacts. Each item has name, organization, email/phone (ContactInfo), tags, stage, owner, last-contacted info and e-commerce order summary. resultsInfo carries totalCount and hasNext/nextIndex: pass nextIndex as `page` for the next page. GET /Contacts.

contact_stage.description: Only contacts in this stage (see revampcrm_list_contact_stages).

deal_stage.description: Only contacts that have a deal in this stage.

assigned_user_id.description: Only contacts owned by this user id.

email.description: Only contacts with this email value.

phone.description: Only contacts with this phone number.

subscribed.description: Subscription filter as Revamp CRM numbers it.

added_from.description: Created on or after this date.

added_to.description: Created on or before this date.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g. name, createdon, updatedon).

page.description: Page index as in the previous reply's resultsInfo.nextIndex (default: the first page).

tools.name: revampcrm_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id with full details: contact info, address, tags, stage, custom fields, owner, previous/next task, deal totals (won/lost/open per currency), e-commerce order summary and order details. GET /Contacts/GetSingleContact/{id}/true.

contact_id.description: Revamp CRM contact id (_id from revampcrm_list_contacts).

tools.name: revampcrm_list_contact_deals
tools.title: List a contact's deals
tools.description: All deals of one contact (name, stage, status, value, currency, expected closing date, owner). GET /Contacts/{id}/Deals.

tools.name: revampcrm_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals with optional filters (status, pipeline, owner, contact, currency, created / expected-closing / closed date ranges). Each deal has name, stage, status, value, probability, forecasted sale, expected closing date, contact, owner and tags. The deal endpoints have no paging: the reply is cut to `limit` and says how many matched. GET /Deals/List.

status.description: Deal status filter as existing deals show it, e.g. "Open", "Won" or "Lost".

owner_user_id.description: Only deals owned by this Revamp CRM user id.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date.

expected_close_from.description: Expected closing date on or after this date.

expected_close_to.description: Expected closing date on or before this date.

closed_from.description: Closed (won/lost) on or after this date.

closed_to.description: Closed (won/lost) on or before this date.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g. Value, CreatedOn, ExpectedClosureDate).

limit.description: Show at most this many deals, 1-200 (default 50). The reply says how many matched in total.

tools.name: revampcrm_search_deals
tools.title: Search deals
tools.description: Search deals by name, status, stage, contact, owner, pipeline, product, sales region or deal source (text match as Revamp CRM defines it). Revamp CRM applies `limit` itself and gives no total: may_have_more is true when a full page came back. GET /Deals/Search.

expected_close_date.description: A date as Revamp CRM accepts it, e.g. 2026-10-31.

limit.description: Show at most this many deals, 1-200 (default 50). The reply says how many matched in total.

tools.name: revampcrm_list_deals_by_stage
tools.title: List deals grouped by stage
tools.description: The deal pipeline board: deals grouped by stage (with the stage names in CurrentStages). Same filters as revampcrm_list_deals. At most `limit` deals are shown per stage. GET /Deals/ByStage.

status.description: Deal status filter as existing deals show it, e.g. "Open", "Won" or "Lost".

owner_user_id.description: Only deals owned by this Revamp CRM user id.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date.

expected_close_from.description: Expected closing date on or after this date.

expected_close_to.description: Expected closing date on or before this date.

closed_from.description: Closed (won/lost) on or after this date.

closed_to.description: Closed (won/lost) on or before this date.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g. Value, CreatedOn, ExpectedClosureDate).

limit.description: Show at most this many deals per stage, 1-200 (default 50).

tools.name: revampcrm_get_note
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: One note or timeline entry by id: text/message, type, author, related contact and deal, created date. GET /Notes/getNote/{id}.

tools.name: revampcrm_get_order
tools.title: Get e-commerce order
tools.description: One synced e-commerce order (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce ...) by the store's own order id: totals, tax, discount, shipping, financial and shipping status, line items and customer. Needs the provider name and store name exactly as Revamp CRM stores them (see ExternalProviders / Shop on a contact). GET /Orders/Get/{provider}/{store}/{id}.

store.description: Store name / domain as Revamp CRM stores it.

order_id.description: The order id in the store.

tools.name: revampcrm_count_orders
tools.title: Count e-commerce orders
tools.description: How many orders Revamp CRM has synced for one store. GET /Orders/Count/{provider}/{store}.

store.description: Store name / domain as Revamp CRM stores it.

tools.name: revampcrm_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact (person or organization) in the Revamp CRM account. It does not email or message the contact. Search first (revampcrm_list_contacts with keyword/email) so you do not create a duplicate: this tool does not check. Returns Revamp CRM's import result (status, message, the new id in ImportingIntoId). POST /Contacts/New.

name.description: Full name of the contact (or of the organization).

country.description: Country as Revamp CRM stores it (code or name; see an existing contact).

tags.description: Tags, comma separated. On an update this REPLACES the contact's tags.

contact_type.description: Contact type as Revamp CRM names it (see an existing contact).

assigned_user_id.description: Id of the Revamp CRM user who owns the contact (revampcrm_get_current_user returns your own).

custom_fields.description: Custom fields by Revamp property name, e.g. {"CustomField1": "Gold", "CustomField101": 42}. revampcrm_list_custom_fields explains what each one means.

tools.name: revampcrm_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact. Only the fields you pass change: the tool reads the stored contact first and sends it back with your changes (Revamp CRM's update replaces the whole record). `tags` replaces the contact's tags; passing a field overwrites its old value. It does not email or message the contact. PUT /Contacts/Edit.

contact_id.description: Revamp CRM contact id to update.

name.description: Full name of the contact (or of the organization).

country.description: Country as Revamp CRM stores it (code or name; see an existing contact).

tags.description: Tags, comma separated. On an update this REPLACES the contact's tags.

contact_type.description: Contact type as Revamp CRM names it (see an existing contact).

assigned_user_id.description: Id of the Revamp CRM user who owns the contact (revampcrm_get_current_user returns your own).

custom_fields.description: Custom fields by Revamp property name, e.g. {"CustomField1": "Gold", "CustomField101": 42}. revampcrm_list_custom_fields explains what each one means.

tools.name: revampcrm_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a new deal (opportunity) in the Revamp CRM account, optionally linked to a contact. It does not message anyone. Use revampcrm_list_deals_by_stage (CurrentStages) for valid stage names and revampcrm_list_deal_currencies for currencies. POST /Deals.

value.description: Deal value in `currency` (required by Revamp CRM).

deal_stage.description: Stage name in the pipeline (required by Revamp CRM; see revampcrm_list_deals_by_stage CurrentStages).

status.description: Deal status as existing deals show it (see revampcrm_list_deals). Default "Open".

owner_user_id.description: Revamp CRM user id of the deal owner.

tools.name: revampcrm_add_note
tools.title: Add note to a contact or deal
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a contact or a deal timeline in Revamp CRM. It is an internal note: nothing is sent to the contact. Adding twice creates two notes. POST /Notes/{Contact|Deal}/{id}/Add.

entity_type.description: What the note is attached to.

entity_id.description: The contact id or deal id.

tools.name: revampcrm_mark_deal_won
tools.title: Mark deal won
tools.description: WRITE: mark a deal as Won in Revamp CRM (its status changes and it counts in won-deal reports). It does not message the contact. Check the deal first with revampcrm_search_deals. POST /Deals/Won.

deal_id.description: Revamp CRM deal id (_id or DealId of a deal).

note.description: Optional note stored with the change.

tools.name: revampcrm_mark_deal_lost
tools.title: Mark deal lost
tools.description: WRITE: mark a deal as Lost in Revamp CRM with a reason (its status changes and it counts in lost-deal reports). It does not message the contact. Check the deal first with revampcrm_search_deals. POST /Deals/Lost.

deal_id.description: Revamp CRM deal id (_id or DealId of a deal).

note.description: Optional note stored with the change.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Revamp CRM
prompts.description: What you can do with Revamp CRM here, with example requests to try.
